author: John Hammond
description:
Digging into the Hunt.io Attack Capture API on a live stream and thinking about how we could use those listings for the Minecraft project.

The idea was to treat open-directory listings as the basis for the world, so I was looking at the API and a few example requests to figure out what we could actually pull into the project.

Full video: https://youtu.be/Jx0G9IQxc4s?si=Q0DQzM2_ns0-YfZo
title: Hunt.io Attack Capture
